# All tables (generated by analyse.py)

Intervals are 95% event-bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples of whole events).

## Coverage

Markets collected = clean binary markets above the volume floor whose prices were requested. Open Nd+ = had been open at least N days. Priced = a reference price was found within 12 hours before the horizon. In 3-97% = the slope sample. Polymarket: 1,176,675 closed markets listed above the $1,000 floor, 99,778 clean binary markets in the price sample. Kalshi: 224,977 markets fetched from sampled events, 73,705 binary, settled yes/no, with 1,000+ contracts.

## Power

Smallest change in slope (after minus before) detectable with 80% power in a two-sided 5% test. The event-bootstrap column is the one to use: it allows for markets in the same event moving together. The 7-day rows are the primary test; other horizons are secondary.

## PRIMARY TEST: change in slope at 7 days

Before = closed before 1 Feb 2026; after = closed on or after 1 Mar 2026; February 2026 dropped. A negative change means less favourite-longshot bias after the papers. Bootstrap p = twice the smaller share of bootstrap changes on one side of zero.

| Kalshi | 7 | 1.00 (0.94 to 1.06) | 5309 | 1.07 (1.00 to 1.14) | 4994 | 0.07 (-0.02 to 0.16) | 0.12 |
